scope: Independent source review of layout observers, record context, keyboard/ARIA, style cascade, language creation boundaries and dedicated-instance asset routes.

findings.problem: A delayed contact restore for customer A could remove customer B's current related panel before checking record ownership, then leave B stuck loading.
findings.fix: Validate the open record context before any DOM change; validate the original connected panel and record context after restore success/failure; guard asynchronous reads against body replacement.
new_cases: stale decorate entry starts no request and changes no current panel
restore response after A-to-B navigation preserves B
restore response after record close changes no DOM
current-record restore still refreshes its panel
stale restore failure cannot show a different record an unrelated error

checks: tab creation settles with one tablist and three complete ARIA associations
overview is the only initially visible record panel
related tab hides the other panels
Home moves selection and keyboard focus to overview
ArrowRight moves to Activity with roving tab stops
contact refresh preserves related selection and its controller context
language relabeling preserves the selected record section
menu opening focuses its first item and sets expanded
Escape closes menu and returns focus to the trigger
moving focus outside closes the menu
presentation observers settle instead of scheduling an infinite loop
unlayered design typography wins and functional hidden still wins

source_review.observer_loop: No child-list observer loop found. Tab labels and chart HTML have value guards; attributes and focus do not retrigger child-list observers. Synthetic browser recorded six callbacks and settled.
source_review.record_tabs: One tablist, valid tab/panel ARIA references, one selected and visible panel, roving keyboard focus and related selection survive replacement.
source_review.menu: Arrow navigation, Escape focus return and outside-focus dismissal passed in the isolated Chrome fixture.
source_review.css: Legacy CSS is wrapped in named @layer legacy; design-system.css is unlayered and loaded afterward. Native Chrome computed the declared 13px button style while the functional hidden rule still hides panels.
source_review.icons: Static reviewed SVG bodies have no user-interpolated paths; wrapper icons are aria-hidden. No external SVG references are introduced.
source_review.languages: Workspace/login normalize to en/zh; Agent/report/settings creation is en/zh-only. Historical database text and four-language quotation print remain intentionally readable.
source_review.assets: Dedicated template allowlists logo PNG, brand mark, local font and license. Its offline route checker validates GET bytes, HEAD and rejected POST; final deployment remains root-owned.

limitations: Chrome checks used synthetic offline DOM and the shipped layout script, not production data or API sessions.
The separate agent owns live visual and nested-dialog focus validation.
The initial offline fixture was corrected to model asynchronous record arrival and the actual declared 13px button style; only the final 13/13 browser result is acceptance evidence.
